scientific_integrity: Analytic proof included; finite numerical comparisons support normalization but are not infinite proofs. No independent validation has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: Theorem treats only \(f_d(x)=\|x\|_2^2\) under the standard Gaussian and degree at most r. Uniform results for arbitrary objectives or other reference measures are not claimed. Varying-parameter Laguerre results may offer an alternative derivation; priority still requires independent appraisal.
title: A sharp square-root dimension barrier for Gaussian polynomial-density optimization
